prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, late 20s goddess, Polynesian goddess physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person; a powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere; thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing; her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame; solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, voluminous curls chestnut brown hair — wearing a skin-tight ultra-high-cut micro swimsuit of ultra-thin matte scarlet-red spandex, made of two small triangle cups held by a single narrow V-shaped strap of the same spandex that comes down from behind her neck, passes over both cups and runs straight down the center of her stomach to merge into the front of the bottom, a short closed zipper running down the center of the strap with the zipper teeth visible, her waist sides, her flanks, her stomach and the skin around the straps bare, the bottom is only a small triangle at the front cut extremely high up to the very top of her hip bones, her hips, thighs and legs completely bare, the spandex shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her arms bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small beauty mark beside her navel and slightly darker skin over her elbows. The garments cling like a second skin and shows real material behaviour: the thin spandex molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, the dip of her navel, her ribs, her hip bones and the roundness of her bust and hips, the V strap pressing lightly into her skin, the zipper teeth glinting down the center, fine stretch lines and a soft matte sheen. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame — most extreme Polynesian goddess silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of glossy scarlet red leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her whole hand, in scarlet red lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights.

Background: a bright spring garden terrace of pale stone with blooming tulip beds, a low trimmed hedge, a standard-height garden gate and a bench, in warm golden late-afternoon light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
